💡 كيف تقلل تكلفة سيارتك الشهرية الحقيقية: 💡 How to cut your car's real monthly cost
بعد أن ترى رقمك الحقيقي، إليك أفكاراً عم: Once you see your real number, here are practical ideas to bring it down:
قارن أسعار التأمين كل سنة عند التجديد: Compare insurance prices every year at renewal
— تختلف أسعار شركات التأمين كثيراً لنفس: — Insurers' prices vary a lot for the same coverage, and many people renew automatically with the same company without comparing, which can cost them tens of dinars a year.
الصيانة الدورية أرخص من الإصلاح الطارئ: Regular maintenance is cheaper than emergency repairs
— تجاهل تبديل الزيت أو الفلاتر في موعدها: — Skipping oil or filter changes on time saves money in the short run, but raises the chance of a bigger, costlier breakdown later. Try to count regular maintenance as a fixed monthly expense instead of being surprised by it.
طريقة القيادة تؤثر في استهلاك الوقود بشك: Your driving style directly affects fuel consumption
— التسارع المفاجئ، والفرملة القوية، وترك: — Sudden acceleration, hard braking and idling the engine for no reason all increase consumption. Calm, steady driving can make a noticeable difference to your monthly fuel bill.
قبل أن تشتري سيارة جديدة، احسب كلفتها ال: Before buying a new car, calculate its full monthly cost, not just the installment
— سيارة بقسط أقل لكن استهلاكها مرتفع أو: — A car with a lower installment but high fuel consumption or expensive insurance (especially newer cars or ones with big engines) can cost more overall than a car with a higher installment and lower running costs.
الإهلاك عادةً أكبر مصروف \"غير مرئي\" في: Depreciation is usually a car's biggest “invisible” expense
— تفقد السيارات الجديدة جزءاً كبيراً من: — New cars lose a large part of their value in the first two or three years. If you want to reduce that loss, a reasonably aged used car may be a smarter financial decision than a new one.

ما المصاريف التي ينساها الناس عادةً عند: What expenses do people usually forget when calculating car costs?
كثير من الناس يحسبون القسط الشهري والبنز: Many people count only the monthly installment and fuel, and forget: annual insurance, annual licensing fees, the periodic inspection, regular maintenance, washing, and parking fees. Together, these expenses can make up a large share of a car's real monthly cost.
كيف أقارن تكلفة سيارة بنزين مع سيارة كهر: How do I compare the cost of a petrol car with an electric car?
لسيارة البنزين، احسب استهلاكها باللتر لك: For a petrol car, calculate its consumption in liters per 100 km multiplied by the fuel price and your monthly kilometers. For an electric car, compare your electricity bill before and after getting the car and enter only the difference, not the whole bill, because the rest of the bill belongs to your normal household use.
